idea-plugin.name: RobotsReader
idea-plugin.description:
See what your robots.txt actually does — in plain language, right next to the file. Open any robots.txt and RobotsReader adds a live preview that decodes it, instead of leaving you to read raw Disallow lines.

  • AI crawlers — a table of known AI bots (ClaudeBot, GPTBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider, CCBot…) showing which are blocked or allowed, by name or via *, with notes (e.g. "Applebot-Extended is an AI-training token, not Applebot").
  • All rules — every User-agent group summarized as Allows everything, Blocks everything, or Specific rules.
  • Sitemaps — listed and clickable.
  • Live — the preview updates as you edit; it's a split editor (raw on the left, decoded on the right).
  • Any site — Tools ▸ Open robots.txt from Website… fetches and decodes a live domain's file.
  • Validate sitemaps — right-click ▸ Validate Sitemap(s) fetches the sitemaps (follows index files, gunzips .gz) and checks the pages: URLs blocked by robots.txt, duplicates, protocol limits, http-not-https, host mismatch, and more.

Works in all JetBrains IDEs. Guidance only — well-behaved crawlers obey robots.txt; it is not a security control.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.4 — Sitemap validation: right-click a robots.txt ▸ Validate Sitemap(s) to fetch its sitemaps (index files + .gz supported) and check the pages — URLs blocked by robots.txt, duplicates (with where), protocol limits, http, host mismatch, lastmod. Results in a dockable tool window with Stop/Rerun.

0.1.3 — use a unique language id so RobotsReader can coexist with other robots.txt plugins without a conflict.

0.1.2 — the IDE now offers to install RobotsReader when you open a robots.txt without it (plugin-advertiser discovery).

0.1.1 — compatibility fix: requires 2024.2+ (the split-preview editor API is binary-incompatible with older builds).

0.1.0 — first release: split-editor preview, plain-language rule summaries, sitemaps, language support (highlighting, structure, references, completion, hover docs), guided builder, and fetch-by-domain.

action.description: Fetch and decode a live website's robots.txt
Create a robots.txt with a guided builder
Insert a User-agent block (with a suggested crawler name)
Fetch the sitemaps listed in this robots.txt and check the pages (incl. URLs blocked by robots.txt)
